responses.text: By Mars these weaklings die easily.
Don't get in my way!
Try to keep up, if you can.
Now is the time for killing, not words!
This was all too easy.
I long to join my brethren in the power plant below. The fighting's probably fiercer there.
Our orders are to take and hold this section of the dam.
These men fight hard, and die well.
Ha ha, isn't it glorious?
These dogs are putting up a fight, I'll give them that.
The exterior is ours. The interior will fall soon.
There's talk of much land and slaves going to the one who kills Oliver. If only I wasn't assigned here!
With the outside secured, the poor fools inside have nowhere to run.
Oliver's head is as good as mine!
Is it true the fighting outside has stopped already?
Upstairs, or down? If I were a coward, where would I hide?
Make good use of cover. The time to strike is when they reload.
Their guns aren't quite as effective in these close quarters.
Soon this place will belong to the Legion.
I've added eight notches to my belt already. How many for you?
